notes.market_scope: one globally fixed numbered VLCC pool allocated across four named route buckets plus one residual VLCC market
notes.supply_scope: 900 numbered vessels are conserved; 70 are structurally unavailable, while 830 are divided among route pools, idle ships and vessels in repositioning
notes.calibration_scope: named-route cargo is multiplied by a representative VLCC share rather than assuming every barrel on every long-haul route uses a VLCC; the residual bucket is calibrated to leave ordinary worlds with a meaningful prompt/open-tonnage cushion
notes.idle_scope: idle represents globally open or uncommitted prompt tonnage, not necessarily commercially laid-up vessels
notes.route_scope: the four named buckets read actual seeded route cargo; the residual bucket scales with tonne-mile demand from all remaining crude routes, including sparse Gulf-to-Europe VLCC liftings
notes.price_scope: tightness is priced in constant 2025 dollars and converted to nominal dollars using the seed CPI price-level index
notes.limitations: route pools are vessel-equivalent commercial circuits; individual loading, laden, discharge and ballast phases are not yet tracked per ship
